content: rqlite/dqlite (GitHub + author blog + rqlite.io features docs): Raft+SQLite CP systems. rqlite: single Go binary, HTTP API; per-query read consistency levels none (local, stale), weak (leader, stale), strong (linearizable via Raft ReadIndex; linearizable follower reads added later); hot backup streamed over HTTP from any node (/db/backup), restore to bootstrap nodes; Blob API for large binary objects; join/leave APIs, read-only nodes; TLS; compression; no message size limit. Verified negative: no per-key watch/subscribe API - since v9.0 (Sept 2025) rqlite offers queue-based CDC streaming SQLite changesets (row-level, drained via HTTP, no per-key filtering). dqlite: embedded Go library Raft+SQLite for apps that link it.
